assumptions.gross_exposure: $1000/$5000/$10000 per pool at initial USDCUSD=1, includes borrowed principal once; planning values, not actual caps
assumptions.coverage: 100% modeled aggregate LP shortfall versus HOLD ORIGINAL USDC DEPOSITS plus necessary costs once
assumptions.initial_zap: Costless conversion to50/50 PYUSD/USDC at initial prices1USD; real zap cost UNKNOWN in C
assumptions.wide_band: [0.5,2] PYUSD/USDC relative price, fixed/no recenter, hypothetical not Aquarius tick config
assumptions.fees_rewards: No fee/reward credit in loss-only model, no APR forecast; actual income/missed fees unknown
assumptions.existing_seed_credit_usdc: 0 (no verified credit, not assertion that actual balances are zero)
assumptions.future_replenishment: 50% actually collected eligible future income only under prospective approved ownership policy
assumptions.liquidity_stress: 50% third-party removal at hour1; actual depth, fees, price impact, fillability UNKNOWN
assumptions.outage: 24h and72h; no executable exits during outage; assumed in-kind exits at reopening/+1/+2h are conditional
assumptions.exit_order: concurrent50/30/20% gross positions, largestfirst; no fee/reward netting against booked claims
assumptions.seed_units: USDC; lossUSD/usdcUSD each boundary; no guarantee USDC preservesUSD purchasingpower
assumptions.costs: C includes necessary zap/unwind/recovery/slippage/resource/restoration costs ONCE; omitted argument means UNKNOWN not zero
assumptions.contingency: 0/25/50% on modeled loss+C; scenario margins not probability estimates
